optimizedDescription.value: Defines passive, shell, and external workflow hooks plus binding-driven timing, failure, ordering, skipping, and progress.

optimizedContext.value:
# Hook Execution Model

## Rules
- Hook entry has id + exactly one `instruction:`, `run:`, or `external:{type,config}`; invalid combination → `SchemaValidationError`. Every workflow step supports all forms.
- `instruction:` is passive text returned only by `GetHookInstructions(step, phase, hookId?)`; never process/check/effect/`CompileContext`. `run:` executes only through `HookRunner`; never agent context. External dispatches only to runner supporting `external.type`; missing runner fails clearly.
- `TransitionChange` / `ArchiveChange` execute matching run/external effects after predicates pass. Matcher, slot, failure come from binding, never check ID/private hook path. Hook check owns `RunStepHooks` dependency.
- Transition defaults: `hook.pre` any except recovery, `hook.post` forward only; both `before-persist`, `abort`. Archive: pre `before-persist`/abort; post `after-persist`/collect. Before-persist abort throws `HookFailedError` and preserves prior state/files; collect records and continues.
- Standalone `RunStepHooks`: pre fail-fast; post continues/collects; CLI exits 2 on failure. It is sole hook execution engine for checks and CLI. `Change` executes nothing.
- Ordering per phase: schema hooks declaration order, then matching project `schemaOverrides` declaration order.
- Transition `skipHookPhases`: source.pre/source.post/target.pre/target.post/all; archive: pre/post/all. Skip only effects, never predicates. Since transition pre/post share before-persist, selection uses binding phase plus pre/post selector identity. Manual callers preserve `along` filtering.
- Manual sequence: hook instruction pre → run-hooks pre → lifecycle command with skip selector → run-hooks post → hook instruction post.
- `HookRunner` expands and shell-escapes `{{change.name}}`, `{{change.path}}`, `{{project.root}}`; unknown token preserved. No `{{change.workspace}}`; derive touched workspaces from specIds.

## Constraints
- Pre hooks always fail-fast. Transition source.post is forward-only and aborts before persist. Archive post is collect after persist.
- Use cases select effects by binding phase/onFailure and never launch `RunStepHooks` by ID.
- `--skip-hooks` skips effects only.
